main.summary: Notification event type emitted by DataControl publishers to wake follow and resume workflows.

value.name: DataAppended
value.summary: New stream bytes became durably available for a followed transfer session.

value.name: DataRealized
value.summary: New segmented or staged-follow content became durably realized for a followed transfer session.

value.name: TransferCompleted
value.summary: The source transfer reached complete state and can wake followers to finish draining or transition their local state.

value.name: TransferCommitted
value.summary: The source transfer committed its final item state and can wake followers to reconcile and materialize the committed result.

value.name: TransferAborted
value.summary: The source transfer aborted and can wake followers to stop waiting and reconcile terminal state.
